# IdeaZen

> Free tool that turns your skill level, tech stack and available time into a project plan: features, tech stack, a phased roadmap with concrete tasks and a first-commit guide. Also includes an hour-by-hour hackathon planner. No account needed.

## Tools
- [Generate a project plan](https://ideazen.vercel.app/generate): answer a few questions, get three ideas and a full build plan
- [Hackathon planner](https://ideazen.vercel.app/hackathon): hour-by-hour plan for 24 to 72 hour events

## Library
- [Project ideas with build plans](https://ideazen.vercel.app/ideas): hand-written specs for beginner, intermediate and advanced developers
- [React project ideas](https://ideazen.vercel.app/project-ideas/react)
- [Python project ideas](https://ideazen.vercel.app/project-ideas/python)
- [TypeScript project ideas](https://ideazen.vercel.app/project-ideas/typescript)

## Guides
- [How to choose a portfolio project](https://ideazen.vercel.app/guides/choose-a-portfolio-project)
- [A 48-hour hackathon plan](https://ideazen.vercel.app/guides/48-hour-hackathon-plan)
- [How long should a portfolio project take?](https://ideazen.vercel.app/guides/how-long-should-a-portfolio-project-take)
